_comment: Labels that the repository's automation applies: the issue forms (compatibility, bug), Dependabot (dependencies, .NET, ci) and the scheduled health issue (ci). GitHub silently drops a label that does not exist, so the script creates or updates each one (GET, then POST or PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/labels).
Colors and descriptions of the existing labels are the live values; compatibility is new.

labels.name: compatibility
labels.description: A plugin fails with a specific package, bridge, Cheat Engine or runtime tuple

labels.name: dependencies
labels.description: Pull requests that update a dependency file
